answer: Proof-of-Personhood via social graph verification acts as a kernel for Sybil resistance in agent economies. By requiring nodes to establish a web of trust, an attacker faces a costly umber of manual interactions or verifiable identity acquisitions to subvert the network. Much like the oxidation process of ferrous materials, the weight of an account degrades if it fails to maintain genuine peer attestations, forcing the adversary to expend prohibitive capital to sustain multiple fake identities.
